description: This file implements the LifecycleManager class for a plugin in the WPEFramework. It manages application lifecycle events, registration of notifications, app launching, state changes, and event handling related to runtime and window manager events. It interacts with other components like RequestHandler and ApplicationContext to control application states and respond to system events.

classes.name: LifecycleManagerImplementation
classes.description: Main class implementing the lifecycle management for applications within the plugin, handling registration, event dispatching, app control, and event responses.

methods.name: initialize
methods.description: Initializes the lifecycle manager with the provided service.

methods.name: terminate
methods.description: Cleans up resources and terminates the lifecycle manager.

methods.name: Register
methods.description: Registers a notification callback for app lifecycle events.

methods.name: Unregister
methods.description: Unregisters a previously registered notification callback.

methods.name: dispatchEvent
methods.description: Dispatches an event to be processed asynchronously.

methods.name: Dispatch
methods.description: Handles the dispatching of specific lifecycle events based on the event type.

methods.name: GetLoadedApps
methods.description: Retrieves information about currently loaded applications.

methods.name: IsAppLoaded
methods.description: Checks if an application with the given appId is loaded.

methods.name: SpawnApp
methods.description: Launches a new application instance asynchronously.

methods.name: SetTargetAppState
methods.description: Changes the target state of a loaded application.

methods.name: UnloadApp
methods.description: Initiates a graceful shutdown of an application.

methods.name: KillApp
methods.description: Forcefully terminates an application.

methods.name: SendIntentToActiveApp
methods.description: Sends an intent (e.g., deeplink) to an active application.

methods.name: Register
methods.description: Registers a notification callback for application state changes.

methods.name: Unregister
methods.description: Unregisters a notification callback for application state changes.

methods.name: AppReady
methods.description: Signals that an app is ready.

methods.name: StateChangeComplete
methods.description: Indicates that a state change has completed for an app.

methods.name: CloseApp
methods.description: Closes an application with a specified reason.

methods.name: Configure
methods.description: Configures the lifecycle manager with the provided service.

methods.name: getContext
methods.description: Retrieves the application context for a given appInstanceId or appId.

methods.name: onRuntimeManagerEvent
methods.description: Handles runtime manager events.

methods.name: onWindowManagerEvent
methods.description: Handles window manager events.

methods.name: onRippleEvent
methods.description: Handles ripple events (currently commented out).

methods.name: onStateChangeEvent
methods.description: Handles application state change events.

methods.name: handleRuntimeManagerEvent
methods.description: Processes runtime manager event data.

methods.name: handleStateChangeEvent
methods.description: Processes application state change event data.

methods.name: handleWindowManagerEvent
methods.description: Processes window manager event data.
